en.title: The Humidity of Digital Afterglow
en.premise: In a world where people routinely offload inconvenient memories and emotions to the cloud to avoid heartache, a memory‑organizer works to sort the stored recollections. He/she discovers a stray artificial intelligence with no registered owner. The AI carries an old memory of the “Hill of Promise,” a place that has faded from everyone’s mind. This story follows the quest to reclaim the aching, bittersweet feeling that was sacrificed for convenience.

zh.title: 数字残照的湿度
zh.premise: 在一个人们为了逃避心灵创伤，习惯把不便的记忆和情感存入云端的世界，主人公从事记忆整理工作，偶然捡到一枚没有所有者的“迷路人工智能”。这枚AI携带着一段关于“约定之丘”的古老记忆——一个已被所有人遗忘的地方。故事讲述他/她在便利的代价下，试图找回那种压在胸口的、令人心酸的感情。
